headline: Wave B3 (5 iterations, 39.13 GPU h) ends with B3a as the best run: B2f + paired JS consistency (--consistency js --consistency_lambda 0.3 --consistency_pairs both, --batch_size 8). On the half_B top-5 merge it scored 93.06 vs B2f 91.98: delta +1.08, CI [+0.52, +1.67], clean drop 0.12, promote / positive (iter01/verdict.json). The final epoch is 92.94 (+0.80) but marked revisit because its clean F1 fell 0.63. The gain is ranking: heldout F1 +2.28, noisy EER 10.09 -> 9.16, and 0.5 is now the optimal threshold. Every one-flag change on top of B3a was negative with the CI excluding 0: balanced sampler -0.83, JS weight 1.0 -0.77, random Opus codec profiles -2.20, SNR 0-20 dB -1.06. Harder augmentation cut late-training fit and hit heldout bona most. The p>=0.99 noisy-bona core (16-22 %) and the noise_only / sil_only probes (99-100 % spoof) never moved. B3a rests on one seed and the recipe's seed band is unmeasured.

recommended_full_run.flags: python -u -m b3wave.train --train_data_path /mnt/paml-research/RTCFake/data/wav/train --train_protocol /mnt/paml-research/RTCFake/data/train_label.txt --dev_data_path /mnt/paml-research/RTCFake/data/wav/dev --dev_protocol ../data/dev_noisy_sim/dev_label_excl_halfB.txt --ssl_name Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B --n_layers 24 --batch_size 8 --num_epochs 8 --num_workers 64 --use_rtc_aug --aug_noise_dirs ../data/augmentation_train/rnnoise ../data/augmentation_train/esc50 --aug_rir_dirs ../data/augmentation_train/rirs --musan --musan_dir ../data/augmentation/musan --loudness_norm --loudness_norm_lufs -23 --optim adamw --lr 2.5e-6 --head_lr_mult 10 --weight_decay 0.01 --lr_scheduler warmup_cosine --warmup_frac 0.05 --lr_min 5e-7 --grad_clip 1.0 --ema_decay 0.9995 --local_eval_sets ../configs/local_eval_sets.yaml --earlystop_metric wf1 --earlystop_epoch 99 --keep_topk_by_wf1 7 --keep_epochs 8 --consistency js --consistency_lambda 0.3 --consistency_pairs both --seed <SEED> --track FB3_qwen17_rtc_musan_loud23_cos8_lr2.5e6_cjs03_s<SEED>  (run from SLS_setup/; = B3a config.yaml command with seed/track per run; all other B3 flags at defaults; every eval with --loudness_norm --loudness_norm_lufs -23)
recommended_full_run.readout: Per seed: the half_B top-5 merge (local_eval/merge_top5, model_merging_top5/submission.zip from /post-train-eval, baseline B3a merge_top5). This is the wave objective. B3a's merge beat its final epoch on half B (93.06 vs 92.94) and half A (93.04 vs 92.61), with no clean drop (0.12 vs 0.63). Also evaluate epoch_8 per seed: the final epoch won 3 of 5 B3 runs. Across seeds, with B3a seed 1234 as the third: the score average (mean p_spoof) of the per-seed merges, kept only if it beats every seed on half_B; a weight average only if it beats both parents. If no new seeds are run: submit B3a's top-5 merge, SLS_setup/exp/B3a_qwen17_rtc_musan_loud23_cos8_lr2.5e6_cjs03_s1234_epoch8_bs8_20261009214846/model_merging_top5/submission.zip. Zero-training candidate: the B2f-ep8 + B3a-ep8 score average, 93.40 on half_B, not yet packed. A seed merge below 92.48 means B3a's gain is inside seed noise.

follow_ups: 1. --llrd 0.9 vs B3a: targets heldout ranking (heldout EER 10.42, R_bona 74.94; English 60.85, g726 71.14, gsm 72.76). Changes no input, so no train/eval mismatch. Falsifier: delta within +-0.5 with heldout EER within +-0.3 of 10.42 -> lower-layer drift is not the limit.

2. --specaug (default masks) vs B3a: targets the saturated tail (9.2 % of noisy bona at p>=0.999, 17.6 % at >=0.99) and the +74 % dev-loss rise. Masking adds no class-ownable artefact. Falsifier: delta within +-0.5 with ep8 dev loss >= 0.17 -> masking does not regularise; delta < -0.5 with ep8 CE > 1.5x0.0283 -> close the input-side levers.

3. --consistency_clean_view vs B3a: the un-augmented view becomes a stop-gradient teacher, targeting bona flipped by degradation (R_bona 92.34 clean vs 79.03 / 74.94 noisy; 180 noisy bona FA). Falsifier: delta within +-0.5 with FA within +-10 of 180 -> the teacher does not transfer.

4. --consistency_lambda 0.0 vs B3a: recipe control for the confound (the JS term vs the paired views + doubled steps). Delta < -0.5 with noisy EER >= 9.46 -> keep JS 0.3; delta > +0.5 -> drop JS from the recipe.
5. Seed repeat --seed 1235 of B3a (folded into the full run): measures the recipe's seed band. A merge < 92.48 means B3a's gain is inside seed noise, and the B3b/B3c/B3e deltas must be re-read.
